ticker_news.title: The Best AI ETF to Invest $500 in Right Now
ticker_news.description: The Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ) is recommended as an excellent ETF for AI investment, tracking the Nasdaq-100 index with strong historical performance and low expense ratio. The ETF provides comprehensive exposure to AI through top tech companies and has generated a 504% return over the past decade.
ticker_news.author: Neil Patel
